summary: String-table lookup and copy helper using the table pointer off_5CCBD8. Caches off_5CCBD8[0], binary-searches it via BinarySearchInStringTable(byte_5EC4C0, off_5CCBD8[0], byte_5EC4CC), and on a match copies the matched string into the global message buffer byte_5EC4CC (null-terminating it when the source pointer is null). Always copies up to a2-1 bytes from byte_5EC4CC into the caller-supplied output buffer a1 via sub_587DD0, null-terminates at a2-1+a1, and returns 0. Called by sub_49DE40 (0049de40), MultiLayerTextRendering (004dbe60), MultiColorTextRender (004dbf90), and UIDebugOverlayRender (004dc0b0).

BinarySearchInStringTable(byte_5EC4C0, off_5CCBD8[0], byte_5EC4CC): search the table for a key string; non-zero return indicates a match.
Only update the message buffer when the table search reports a match.
On match with non-null v2, copy the matched string into the global message buffer: strcpy(byte_5EC4CC, v2).
On match with null v2, clear the message buffer: byte_5EC4CC[0] = 0.
sub_587DD0(a1, byte_5EC4CC, a2 - 1): copy or concatenate the message buffer into the caller output buffer a1 up to a2-1 bytes.
Null-terminate the output buffer at a2-1+a1.
Return 0 unconditionally after filling the output buffer.
